evidence.reason: The `manager_restarted` check at lines 1104-1116 only verifies that both manager PIDs are nonzero and changed, and that both invocation IDs are nonempty and changed. If the guest reboots between the two manager snapshots, both PID and invocation ID will change, so the predicate passes even though the manager restart observations span a reboot. The separate `boot_id_changed` check at lines 1117-1124 applies only to the later reboot phase, not to the manager-restart snapshots. Requiring nonempty, equal boot IDs in the manager before/after snapshots is a small correctness fix and does not add a new contract requirement; the same snapshot structure already exposes `boot_id`, as shown by the reboot checks.
